title: The error cross draws at the mark size on a hairline column
foundBy: session agent of a consuming timeline page, measuring a headless Chromium render; relayed by the repository owner

evidence.verified: The browser test that sizes the error cross to its column fails on the parent commit and passes here. On a hairline mark, at least 8 pixels within 3 of the centre are the error colour, and none 5 or more away. `npm run ci` passes on 791cdaa, with every gate run. The visual gate passes 116 of 116 captures with no differing pixel and no new axe finding. The positioned fixture was re-recorded in 8566fe8. The dense, multi-lane and bar fixtures of the index layout are byte-identical to the baseline before this work. The build was served through `npm run registry:npmrevs` as 0.3.1-dev.20260922083722.8566fe8 and installed into the consuming dispatch viewer. That viewer's run14-1 render was measured in headless Chromium at 1500 by 1000.

resolution: In the positioned layout the cross reaches the smaller of the mark size and the column's width, plus two pixels, and at least three. A hairline keeps a six-pixel cross.
details:
In the positioned layout a dense run draws its marks as columns a pixel or two wide. An `error` event draws a cross whose arms reach the mark size plus two pixels each way, whatever the column's width. At a whole-run view the cross dwarfed the hairline it sat on, measured on a consuming page in headless Chromium at 1500 by 1000.

The cross should be sized to the column it marks, with a floor so that it is still a cross on a hairline.
